description: Source and version state, jurisdictional, local, and discounted HWAU price schedules over time with provenance and support status.

included: Roadmap and contract shape for national, state, local, discounted, blocked, and missing price schedules.
Synthetic serialization checks for price schedule records.
Support-state vocabulary for provenance-aware price schedule work.
excluded: Complete sourced registry implementation for every jurisdiction and year.
Runtime APIs such as PriceRegistry, get_state_price, get_national_price, or list_available_jurisdictions.
Public claims that synthetic constants are official sourced prices.

gap_register.description: The price_registry module currently has synthetic constants and record helpers, but does not expose PriceRegistry, get_state_price, get_national_price, or list_available_jurisdictions APIs.
National, state, local, discounted, missing, and blocked schedule rows still need official provenance records and behavior tests before archive.
